ads.caption: Digiwin advises on manufacturing ERP. For OSAT (outsourced semiconductor assembly and test), month-end close starts with reconciling work in progress, completed output and losses by lot between finance and the factory.

cards.headline:
Month-end is here.
Do the factory records reconcile?
cards.body:
Work in progress, completed output, losses:
reconcile before close.
cards.native_headline: Month-end close starts with factory records
cards.alt: A closing calendar and factory records waiting to be reconciled at a semiconductor plant.

rationale.reader_intent: Reconcile production records before financial close, without implying automatic integration.
rationale.adaptation_note: Replace the Vietnamese chốt ambiguity with reconciliation, keep shared responsibility. Direct operational question without calendar idioms or promised automation.
rationale.reader_question: Have finance and the factory reconciled their records before month-end close?
